title: Flash Dryer
model_title: Flash (Pneumatic) Dryer — Heater, Drying Riser, Cyclone, Exhaust Fan

introduction.definition: A flash (pneumatic) dryer dries wet granular or powdered material while conveying it in a hot gas stream. The feed is dispersed into hot gas at a venturi and carried up a drying duct at high velocity; surface moisture evaporates within seconds. A cyclone separates the product, and an exhaust fan pulls the gas through the system.
introduction.summary: A flash (pneumatic) dryer disperses a wet, granular feed into a stream of hot gas, which carries it up a drying duct at high velocity. Surface moisture evaporates within seconds; a cyclone separates the dry product and an exhaust fan pulls the gas through the system.

working_principle.characteristic_curve: Moisture removed vs gas inlet temperature and duct length; internal moisture needs longer residence (consider ring dryers).

temperature.title: Gas temperature falls quickly up the riser
temperature.description: Hot gas (~ 150–600 °C depending on product) picks up the wet particles at the venturi and carries them up the duct at high velocity (~ 10–30 m/s). Surface moisture flashes off within seconds, so the gas temperature falls rapidly; the short contact time makes flash dryers suitable for heat-sensitive, free-flowing materials with mainly surface moisture.

video_tutorials.title: Flash Dryer — Introduction

script.narration: This module introduces the Flash Dryer.
A flash (pneumatic) dryer dries wet granular or powdered material while conveying it in a hot gas stream.
The feed is dispersed into hot gas at a venturi and carried up a drying duct at high velocity; surface moisture evaporates within seconds.
A cyclone separates the product, and an exhaust fan pulls the gas through the system.
Typical applications include starch, gluten, fibres; mineral concentrates, gypsum, clays; chemicals with mostly surface moisture.
The cutaway reveals the internal construction: Exhaust Fan Impeller (draws the system under suction).
The exploded view separates every component so each one can be tapped for its function, material and failure modes.
Next, watch the operation tutorial to see how it works.

video_tutorials.title: Flash Dryer — Maintenance

script.narration: Maintenance essentials for the Flash Dryer.
Check outlet temperature and product moisture.
Inspect duct bends for erosion; feeder wear.
Fan balancing; cyclone inspection.
Watch for duct build-up: rising ΔP. Common cause: sticky feed, poor dispersion.
Watch for wet product: high moisture. Common cause: low gas temperature, overload.
Record every inspection so trends — vibration, temperature, leakage and performance — can be compared over time.
